# Rima Video Downloader 1.1.0

- Renamed the visible app, installer, Windows metadata and browser companion to Rima Video Downloader.
- Fixed dropped/batch links being replaced by unrelated clipboard suggestions. Batch inspection starts only after the link dialog closes.
- Failed video inspections show the service error rather than an empty-response JSON parser error.
- Added a separate Minimize to tray button. Normal minimize stays on the taskbar, even with an older tray preference saved.
- Preserved existing AppData settings, queue, history, browser pairing, executable and installation identity.
- Includes the reviewed per-user installer and consent-based updater work. Production builds are unsigned. Without a production TUF trust root, updates use the checksum-verified full-installer fallback, not differential updates.

Windows x64. Download only media you have permission to save. No DRM bypass.
